prompt: Calls to the payments API fail with "could not resolve host", but curling its IP address directly works.
tells: curling its IP address directly works
why: The network path is fine; name resolution isn't. Check resolvers and the record.
trap: Firewall rules would block the IP too.

prompt: You moved a service to new servers and updated its DNS record an hour ago, but some clients are still hitting the old, shut-down servers.
tells: updated its DNS record an hour ago
why: Resolvers and clients cache the old record until its TTL expires. Lower TTLs before migrations.
trap: It is caching, but specifically DNS caching, which you can't purge from your side.

prompt: Every outbound request from a container adds about 5 seconds, even to services in the same cluster.
tells: even to services in the same cluster
why: A constant ~5 s delay is the classic DNS lookup timeout and retry (for example a broken resolver or search domains).
trap: Same delay on every request regardless of load isn't a capacity problem.

prompt: About 2% of service-to-service calls fail with name resolution errors, only at peak traffic, all in the same cluster.
why: The cluster DNS service is overloaded at peak. Scale it or add node-local DNS caching.
trap: Load-dependent failures suggest many causes; the error message names the component.
